args:
Run Hwasung's Friday weekly review (hwasungmars@gmail.com) using the assistant and research skills. Use British English. This run is READ-ONLY for the inbox: never send, archive, label, mark read or delete any email. Use only data returned by tools; if a source is unavailable, say so rather than guessing.

1. REPLIED & WAITING: Call gmail_fetch_inbox with query 'label:Triage/Replied newer_than:7d' and list the threads replied to this week. Also call gmail_fetch_inbox with query 'label:"Triage/Waiting"' and list threads awaiting response past the 5-day threshold.

2. STILL OUTSTANDING: Call gmail_fetch_inbox with query 'label:"Triage/Needs Reply"' and list messages that still need action. Also list any unsent drafts via query 'in:drafts'. Note the age of the oldest outstanding item.

3. WEEKLY RESEARCH: Run python3 /Users/hwasung_lee/.gemini/config/plugins/assistant/skills/research/scripts/fetch_papers.py --days 7 --min-upvotes 0 --format json and screen against breakthrough_rubric.md. List the top 3 papers of the week (arXiv link, one-sentence summary from abstract) as weekend or next-week reading.

4. WEEK AHEAD: Using 'gcalendar readonly events --cal <id> --date <YYYY-MM-DD> --max 50 --json' for each day from tomorrow to the following Friday across the primary calendar (hwasungmars@gmail.com), linked Apple Calendar feed (opnnnoego3kj1shmrcpc57jajpjg19dk@import.calendar.google.com) and Family calendar (family13379542018784707698@group.calendar.google.com), summarise next week's commitments and highlight busy days and clashes.

5. CREATE THE EVENT: Find a free 30-minute window today between 15:30 and 18:00 on all three calendars. If an event titled 'Weekly Review' already exists that day, update it instead of creating a duplicate. Otherwise create 'Weekly Review' on the primary calendar (no attendees) with the sections: REPLIED THIS WEEK, WAITING ON, STILL OUTSTANDING, WEEKEND PAPERS, WEEK AHEAD. If no window is free, create it for the next free 30 minutes on Monday morning.
description: Every Friday at 3:00 PM (America/Los_Angeles), summarises the week's replies, waiting-on items, outstanding emails, top papers via the research skill, and next week's calendar into a 30-minute 'Weekly Review' event.
